packageRules.description: Pinned to the versions pi ships. Pi's extension loader aliases typebox to its own bundled copy, so our declaration only types what pi executes and must match it (the HTTP frontend runs without pi and ships the same pin); partial-json is not aliased, but pi-ai pins it exactly and parses the same streams. Both move when pi moves, not on Renovate's schedule.
The harnesses this bridge joins always take their latest release, exempt from the global minimumReleaseAge: the bridge tracks them closely and drops workarounds as soon as they catch up.
Pi updates raise the package.json floors, not only the lockfile, so the declared range names the pi the bridge was built and tested against.

@types/node describes the runtime, so it tracks the Node these packages run on rather than the newest DefinitelyTyped release. Types from a later major describe APIs that are not there and hide ones that were removed, and tsc believes them either way. Raise the ceiling when the toolchain in mise.toml moves.
